aboutMore: ok the real stuff since u asked (u didn't ask) (i'm telling u anyway). i work sundays at the pretzel place in the food court (apron, visor, i fold a pretzel in 4 seconds, timed). i keep a birthday book with 61 names in it and mail a card to EVERY ONE (gel pen, pink, my mom says it's too many stamps and i say it's not enough stamps). thursdays i do manicures at Briar Hill, the nursing home by my church, glitter polish only, and mrs kowalski calls me 'brittney with an e' and i stopped correcting her in august. also i'm in AP stats. nobody knows that. now u know. do NOT tell the waitlist. xoxo

blog.title: why there's a waitlist (a serious post) (still pink)
blog.body: ok so people think the waitlist is mean. it's the opposite. in 7th grade i didn't have a table. for 19 days. i ate in the library behind the atlas shelf and told my mom i had 'a lot of friends in lunch.' on day 20 kayla walked up with a tray and said 'is this seat taken' and it wasn't and she sat and she's been spot 1 ever since. so when i made my first top 8 i swore nobody would ever find out they weren't on it by being left out. thats what the waitlist is. nobody's OUT. everybody's NEXT. if ur on the waitlist ur not rejected ur just not called yet. i keep it in a notebook. there are 43 names. i read it before bed. i've never once crossed a name off. (i moved 6 to spot 8, the notebook doesn't count that as crossing off.) xoxo <3 ok that's the serious one. back to glitter.

blog.title: thursdays at briar hill (the nursing home post)
blog.body: every thursday at 4 i do manicures at Briar Hill. glitter polish only, that's the rule, they won't let me bring the other kind. mrs kowalski gets 'plum sparkle' every week and calls me 'brittney with an e.' mr abernathy asked for ONE thumbnail in blue sparkle 'for luck at bingo.' he won $4. now he's convinced it's me, so i'm booked through december. nobody there has a top 8 but they all have the same top 8: the grandkids, a cat named tuxedo, the nurse named denise, the nurse who isn't denise, and whoever is coming on sunday. nobody ever asks me about my page. they ask if i've eaten. mrs kowalski asked if the internet has 'any good looking widowers.' i said not in my top 8. she said 'put me on the waitlist.' she's #14. she's thrilled. xoxo

blog.title: i showed my top 8 spreadsheet to mr henderson and he went QUIET
blog.body: ok so there's a spreadsheet. there has always been a spreadsheet. columns: texts returned within a day, comments hearted back, 'showed up when it mattered' (x3), 'has seen me cry' (x3), 'returns gel pens' (x2). i printed it for mr henderson because he said in class that data 'should be shared with the community.' he looked at it for like a full minute. then he said 'brittany, this is a weighted multivariate model. you invented regression in a pink font.' then he asked what the thing i'm trying to predict is. i said 'who sits with me.' he said 'that's a very good dependent variable' and took his glasses off and wiped them for no reason. tutoring is tuesdays at 3:15 now. tim says i owe him $2 for 'the formula.' i do not. i did the formula in gel pen first. xoxo

blog.title: the crying pretzel policy (unofficial) (sunday shifts)
blog.body: so there's a rule at the pretzel place that i made up and my manager Renata pretends she doesn't know about. if someone is crying at the food court, i give them a cinnamon sugar pretzel 'on the house.' on the house means my wallet ($1.75). i've given out 22 since june. the boy who didn't make the team. a lady whose car wouldn't start. two sisters fighting about a coat. a little kid whose balloon went into the skylight (the pretzel did NOT fix it but he forgave the balloon). last week dennis from mall security came up and said 'allergies' and i said 'cinnamon or sugar' and he said 'cinnamon' and i said 'on the house' and he cried a little more. he says it was the cinnamon. i love the food court. everybody comes here to feel something and also eat. xoxo

waitlist. (it means 'next.')
